checks.name: every team keeps every season, the unfinished one included
wins and losses are the season-to-date record
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.team_season_record r full outer join (select season, team_id, max(wins_to_date) as wins, max(losses_to_date) as losses from raw.standings group by 1, 2) e using (season, team_id) where r.wins is distinct from e.wins or r.losses is distinct from e.losses
